item.text: {"search_note":"In this pass, I did not find a strong 2024 primary-source example of Khamenei personally using apocalyptic language, direct nuclear-use normalization, or a clearly reckless nuclear threat in his own voice. The evidence is mostly indirect: official doctrine denials on one side, and threats from commanders/advisers in his orbit on the other.
